subject: Rename memory → johnny: Backend service and models
description:
Rename the backend memory service to johnny throughout the AGENT-HUB codebase.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/fastapi` for API patterns, `/sqlalchemy-2-async` for model updates, `/pydantic` for schema updates.

**Scope:**
- Rename `~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/memory/` → `~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/`
- Update all imports across Agent Hub backend
- Rename classes: `MemoryService` → `JohnnyService`, `MemoryScope` → `JohnnyScope`, etc.
- Update API router registration in Agent Hub

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/memory/**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/api/memory.py
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/main.py (router registration)
- All Agent Hub files importing from memory service

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All memory/ references renamed to johnny/
- [ ] All class/function names updated
- [ ] All imports updated
- [ ] Agent Hub backend starts without import errors
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh --backend` completed (in agent-hub)

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
